_readme: Opponents to keep OUT of the pool, beyond what league membership already filters.
Membership is presence in that league's PvPoke ranking (rankings-1500.json,
rankings-2500.json, rankings-10000.json), plus a raw-power floor in Master:
Master is uncapped, so a form that cannot reach 3000 CP is outclassed by
definition and is dropped even when rated. Great and Ultra take no floor.
Ids are refs, the same vocabulary parseRef/makeRef use. A bare id drops the
base form; a _shadow suffix drops the Shadow. The two are separate opponents
because a Shadow's x6/5 attack and x5/6 defense move its breakpoints and
bulkpoints off the base form's, and a league can rate one without the other:
"palkia"          drops Palkia, leaves Shadow Palkia
"palkia_shadow"   drops Shadow Palkia, leaves Palkia
"marowak_alolan"  drops base Alolan Marowak
Put a ref in a league array to drop it in that league only, or in "all" to
drop it everywhere.
Exclusions only affect who appears as an OPPONENT. Every species stays
selectable as your own Pokemon regardless, Shadow toggle included.
Mimikyu, Morpeko and Aegislash are excluded outright. Each carries a mechanic
the simulator does not model - Mimikyu's built-in shield, Morpeko's form
change, Aegislash's stance change - and each behaves so unlike every other
species that it needs its own code path rather than a stat adjustment.
Listing them beats simulating them wrongly and reporting the result as fact.
Otherwise prefer leaving these arrays empty: the ranking does the filtering,
and this file is the manual override for cases it still gets wrong.
Re-run `npm run data` after editing. The generator reports how many were
dropped and warns about refs that match nothing, so typos surface.
